sinopsis.es: La historia verdadera de Bill Wilson, fundador de Alcohólicos Anónimos: un hombre explosivo e impredecible, incapaz de controlar su deseo de alcohol. Su propia incapacidad para ayudarlo separa de él a su sufrida esposa, Lois. Bill intenta dejar de beber, no lo logra y recurre a su amigo el Dr. Bob Smith. Una historia de esperanza, coraje y amor.
sinopsis.en: The true story of Bill Wilson, founder of Alcoholics Anonymous: an explosive and unpredictable man, unable to control his craving for alcohol. Her own inability to help him separates his long-suffering wife, Lois, from him. Bill tries to quit drinking, fails, and turns to his friend Dr. Bob Smith. A story of hope, courage and love.
